## File: google-deepmind_ai-foundations/ai_foundations/ngram/model.py

Prompts

```
['build an NGramModel from a list of text strings with a specified n-gram order', 'estimate conditional probabilities of n-grams from a dataset of text strings', 'generate new text tokens using random sampling from the learned n-gram probability distribution', 'generate new text tokens using greedy sampling from the learned n-gram probability distribution', 'review the NGramModel class and its n-gram probability estimation and text generation methods']
```

Usage

```
{'build_ngram_model': 'build an NGramModel from a list of text strings with a specified n-gram order', 'estimate_ngram_probabilities': 'estimate conditional probabilities of n-grams from a dataset of text strings', 'generate_text_random': 'generate new text tokens using random sampling from the learned n-gram probability distribution', 'generate_text_greedy': 'generate new text tokens using greedy sampling from the learned n-gram probability distribution', 'review_ngram_model': 'review the NGramModel class and its n-gram probability estimation and text generation methods'}
```
